description: 台灣自來水公司給水廠出水能力 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣自來水股份有限公司. 隨著新經濟時代來臨，消費著意識抬頭，自來水又是民眾生活的必需品，所以提供量足質優的自來水是台灣自來水公司的經營目標。 近幾年隨著用戶數持續增加，台灣自來水公司為滿足用戶多元需求，除了要提供高水準的服務，且必須積極開發水資源，提高給水廠的出水能力，以充裕水量，目前在台灣自來水公司同仁共同努力之下，供水大致順利正常。 本資料集係提供台灣自來水... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣自來水股份有限公司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
